empiricalLaws.headline: Refresh one opinionated 'Which AI to Use Right Now' guide every quarter
empiricalLaws.evidence: 5 of Ethan Mollick's Top 10 all-time Substack posts are refreshed editions of Which AI to Use Right Now.

empiricalLaws.headline: Lead with organizational, role, and margin implications over pure protocol specs
empiricalLaws.evidence: Gergely Orosz averages 1,124 likes and 115 comments on role/org implication essays vs 552 likes and 43 comments on pure MCP protocol explainers (2.0x likes, 2.7x comments).

empiricalLaws.headline: Put a concrete dollar cost or minute cap directly in build headlines
empiricalLaws.evidence: 5 of Nate B. Jones's top 7 all-time issues name a bounded build in the headline ($0.10/mo, 45-min fix; 45-minute prompt; 90-minute guide), converting into 15,000+ paid Substack members.

empiricalLaws.headline: Never publish standalone sales announcements without a saveable visual rubric
empiricalLaws.evidence: ByteByteGo visual system taxonomies earn 1,401 likes (Database Types) and 483 likes (Agentic Patterns) vs 79 likes on pure cohort Last Call posts (17.7x engagement drop).
